prompt:
Create a polished, exceptionally clean MOBILE STRATEGY GAME UI component comparison sheet, landscape 1500x1050. The attached image is the APPROVED visual reference, variant C Crisp buttons. Match its circular candy-button nodes exactly: shallow domed smooth M&M-like candy faces, narrow rounded bevel, gentle top-left sheen, very tight soft shadow, soft mint green and cyan and warm ivory, very dark upright rounded legible numerals. Do not reproduce the old approval image's whole layout. This is a focused design study, not a poster or device mockup.
Fixed palette: almost-white warm ground, mint/lime green and cyan nodes, charcoal ink, navy night strip. Keep the FACE and COUNT AREA totally clear: no symbol on top of the numeral, no rotated bars, no noisy highlights over the number. Counts must be centered and legible. Subtle 3D, not spherical marbles, not thick plastic toys. Real crisp designed icons, no emoji, no logos. No crowns, AI icons, or flags anywhere; the user has explicitly removed those.
Include enough whitespace to show the differences cleanly. Draw the nodes at actual plausible game proportions, not icons so huge they would cover a node. Use exact short labels and a consistent modern rounded sans similar to Quicksand. Every sample must look like part of the SAME approved game visual system. No typography experiments or new palette.
TITLE exactly "Economy & Tower".
Make a precise TWO-ROW, THREE-COLUMN comparison, with row names "Economy" and "Tower". All six samples use the same approved circular candy-button node with a centered number 35. Economy row uses mint green, tower row uses cyan. Label each sample with its short unique ID and name below. The six IDs must be clear and unmistakable.
Economy row:
"E1 · Growth bars": three small rising rounded bars as a compact 3D glyph on a tiny badge attached to the upper-right perimeter. Outside the number area. This is the clearest abstract-growth option.
"E2 · Sprout": a tiny friendly two-leaf sprout rising just above the top of the node, no badge plate, a short stem, elegant geometric leaves. This indicates faster unit growth, not money.
"E3 · Generator": a tiny rounded production-building silhouette with a simple plus-shaped opening, attached under the lower edge of the node like a compact base; the candy circle remains intact. It must be as minimal as the other marks, not a factory illustration.
Tower row:
"T1 · Tower badge": a tiny clean single castle-tower silhouette, with three soft crenellations and a narrow doorway, on a compact badge at the upper-right perimeter. No shield shape for this type marker.
"T2 · Tower cap": three small rounded battlements integrated just above the TOP rim of the candy button, suggesting a tower while preserving its circular candy face and centered numeral. Avoid a crown; it is a quiet horizontal castle parapet with square notches.
"T3 · Tower base": a tiny low parapet/fortification base snugly under the lower rim of the candy node, with a compact square turret in its center, all matching the node's candy 3D material. No large pedestal and no numbers inside the base.
Do NOT draw shields, shield arcs, routes or AI marks in these six samples; this comparison isolates the upgrade marker.
Along the bottom, a narrow dark-navy strip repeats the SIX SAME miniature samples in the same order, numbers legible, no extra label clutter. This demonstrates night mode. Keep the sheet compact and highly refined.
